reporting-org.narrative: ORRAAs mission is to build the resilience of 250 million climate vulnerable coastal people by 2030, by deploying at least USD$500 million of investment into coastal and ocean resilience through the development of at least 50 novel finance and insurance products.

title.narrative: The Association for Coastal Ecosystem Services - Bundling biodiversity and blue carbon credits in Vanga Blue Forest

description.narrative: The project aims to result in a sustainable finance stream for the Vanga Blue Forest community for the protection and restoration of coastal ecosystems through a certified highly replicable credit-generating framework.

participating-org.narrative: ACES - The Association for Coastal Ecosystem Services

recipient-country.narrative: This project will benefit communities in Kenya.
